Synthetic field-muting capture on a fresh 30-day Developer scratch org, 2026-11-09. The owned permset_muting/project was extended with Other.field-meta.xml, the supplied two-field MuteGrant and PermMuteOther test class. The two muting metadata variants were independently deployed and actor describe was observed through intentional assertion, with source API 62.0 and 67.0. org.tsv retains field describe results only; the 67.0 both_read Value__c method emitted no observation and is not claimed. Scratch deletion succeeded and its unique description matched one ScratchOrgInfo record with Status Deleted. Two earlier scratch runs failed at deployment because the synthetic fieldPermissions XML entries were not contiguous; both orgs were deleted and verified Deleted, and those failures are not behavioral observations.
